fullDesc: The Colosseum was inaugurated in 80 AD with a hundred days of games. The amphitheatre could hold about 50,000 spectators, who watched gladiator fights and shows.
realFacts: Emperor Vespasian began it and Titus opened it
Built on the site of Nero's lake
It had an awning to shade spectators
It is still the world's largest ancient amphitheatre
